subject: Do I already have an R shared library?

messages.author: c90d4c3171b6dbed
messages.subject: Do I already have an R shared library?
parts:
I see that in order to install Rhipe, I'll need R built as a shared library, and I see instructions on how to do that.

But I may have an R shared library already available in the way my R was built - I see the following in my R installation:

 % ls /opt/R-3.0.2/lib64/R/lib
 libRblas.so*  libRlapack.so*  libR.so*

Is that `libR.so` the library Rhipe is going to need?

Thanks,

 -Ken

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Do I already have an R shared library?
parts:
You have it already then. Yes that is required whenever you build an R
library via source.
